patch_description: This version uses a broader collection of staggered hexagonal-style row layouts, including transposed layouts and controlled perturbations. It performs a first optimization pass over all candidates, conservatively validates each result, retains the strongest feasible candidates, and then spends additional SLSQP iterations only on those elite layouts. This concentrates runtime on promising contact graphs while preserving strict containment and non-overlap through a final global radius scaling step.
